source: Geofabrik South Korea OSM PBF 2026-11-05, original source-way WGS84 coordinates
source_forest_track_type: paved/grade1 OSM highway=track only; excludes user-identified facility walking paths
reason_not_in_repo: Source file is user-owned OSM-derived audit data and is delivered as a user-downloadable artifact; repository retains reproducible exporter and validation schema. It is NOT served as a hiking-map overlay.
accepted_official_input: User-provided officially obtained IMDO line-centerline data reprojected to EPSG:4326 GeoJSON. The tool cannot attest the GIS file's provenance; the user must verify original .prj, provider, vintage, and permission.
validation_principles: 125 unique source way IDs must agree exactly with the v83 held list; the source was clipped outside the OSM park boundary within 1500m using EPSG:32652, then converted back to WGS84.
Any source that lacks IDs, has duplicate parts, changes route_allowed/display_in_map to true, or uses projected non-WGS84 coordinates is rejected.
Multi-fragment ways are compared fragment-by-fragment; disconnected fragments are never stitched into a route.
Even geometry close to a purported official centerline is only a candidate for further documentary/field review; it cannot confirm public access, current trail status, or safe travel.
No synthetic road joins, no geometry promoted into maps or route calculations.
user_interface_changes: version label and explanatory text only; no new buttons, candidate overlays or color distinctions
